mapper.select: select order_item_id, order_id, sku_id, sku_code, quantity, unit_price_amount, discount_amount, tax_amount, line_total_amount, currency_code, create_time from order_items where order_id = #{orderId} order by order_item_id
mapper.insert: insert into order_items (order_id, sku_id, sku_code, quantity, unit_price_amount, discount_amount, tax_amount, line_total_amount, currency_code, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{skuId}, #{skuCode}, #{quantity}, #{unitPriceAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{taxAmount}, #{lineTotalAmount}, #{currencyCode}, sysdate())
